decision_impact: Keep · Core Retained (#1/52); Bliss, GoF & CD38 PD Gates Bounded
headline: SARM1 Parallel Bliss Lower Bound, Rare GoF Ceiling & Off-Target CD38 Fluid Guardrail
prior_state_or_assumption: Combination models of STMN2 rescue plus SARM1 inhibition often assume indirect NMNAT2 epistasis and interpret bulk plasma cADPR drops as direct axonal SARM1 target engagement without bounding rare ARM-GoF residual NADase activity or ecto-CD38 fluid background.
new_evidence_or_revision: Evaluated clinical allosteric SIR2501 (NCT07765446 CIPN Ph2) and reversible orthosteric NB-4746 (NCT07369076) across three modeled bounds: (1) 1.0x parallel Bliss survival additivity (Krus 2022 PMID:35767949; Matson & Holzbaur 2026 DOI:10.64898/2026.11.07.764673) to ~2–7x (med ~3x) NMNAT2-transport-coupled MWC dose-sparing (Beccari 2025 PMID:40392845); (2) ~30–40% residual NADase ceiling at 100x Kd in rare ARM-broken GoF heterozygotes (Gilley 2021 PMID:34796871; Bloom 2022 PMID:34991663); (3) modeled ~5–10% selective cell-free fluid cADPR drop under >90–95% ecto-CD38 fluid background vs ~45–50% implied CD38 inhibition if cell-free plasma cADPR drops -50% (cf. tissue cADPR PMID:32087251; PDB 9TZY BEXi adduct 17 PMID:42156967).
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains EALS-030 (#1/52, Keep · Core) while requiring Cys311Ala non-covalency verification, <1% SARM1 GoF carrier sequencing exclusion, enzymatic CD38 counter-screening, and unbound CSF trough PK.

(2026, J Neurol, PMID:42836993: TRICALS shares r^2 = 12.7% with CSF pNfH; nested pNfH x trt dChi2 = 14.24 vs TRICALS x trt dChi2 = 4.76) separates tryptic CSF MS noise (r = 0.278, PMID:40375307) from clinical immunoassays (serum NfL–CSF pNfH rho = 0.64–0.71, PMID:38683209; serum NfL > serum pNfH on ALSFRS-R slope, PMID:32385188; paired CSF–serum pNfH r = 0.652, PMID:29054919) and notes ~1.8x–4.5x inter-platform pNfH offsets (PMID:31251725; modeled unbridged lower CSF cutoffs reduce 247-death two-sided superiority power from 80% to ~43–50% at HR_high = 1.00 or ~14–23% at HR_high = 1.37), while enrolled N=137 ALSTARS (NCT07161999) stratifies 3 serum NfL tiers on 24-wk ALSFRS-R with dual rhIL-2 + CTLA4-Ig.

headline: Stoichiometric PIKfyve–PI(3)P–LRRK2/CASM Coupling Narrows Pulsed Apilimod Window
prior_state_or_assumption: Intermittent pulsed PIKfyve inhibition (EALS-020) models typically assume an occupancy dead-zone before endolysosomal vacuolation onset (~79% parameter-grid pass rate) without accounting for immediate +PI(3)P-driven LRRK2/CASM stress coupling.

(2026, Life Sci Alliance, PMID:42994990) demonstrated direct, threshold-free PIKfyve -> +PI(3)P -> LRRK2 Rab10-pThr73 / ATG16L1 CASM recruitment alongside Drosophila C9orf72 secreted DPR data (DOI:10.64898/2026.11.09.765393).
